what_it_is: The five dishes that get test sessions first. An R&D priority, not a promised or final menu.
current_members: Chicken 65 Totopos; Paneer Tikka Taco; Goat Birria; Mango Habanero Gobi (appetizer/shareable, D-84); Butter Chicken and Roasted Poblano Quesadilla
status: Designing; nothing cooked; AI planning, not professional review
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: A dish may be dropped, merged or replaced by what Session results show on identity, holding, execution and supply.
must_not_happen: Treating the Core 5 as the opening menu or as tested food.

what_it_is: A guess at which Core 5 items might open. All five are only candidates; the set is decided by Session results, not now.
current_members: NONE DECIDED (all five Core 5 items are candidates only)
status: Hypothesis only; no opening menu is decided
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: Passed holding, identity and D-54 checks plus a chef and kitchen-capacity review could confirm a candidate; failed gates remove it.
must_not_happen: Publishing a final opening menu or promising any dish before Sessions are cooked and reviewed.

what_it_is: Older 12 to 16 item ideas kept as backlog: Chaat Elote, Dal-Frijol Dip, Hefe-brined Wings, Malabar Fish Taco, Tandoori Lamb Taco, Mole-Salan Bowl and others.
current_members: Backlog only: Chaat Elote; Dal-Frijol Dip; Hefe-brined Wings; Malabar Fish Taco; Tandoori Lamb Taco; Mole-Salan Bowl; Mushroom quesadilla; pizzas; biryani
status: Historical ideas; none are opening items
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: A backlog item moves up only if Core 5 results leave an identified gap (vegetarian balance, a cooler dish, a lighter dish).
must_not_happen: Counting backlog items as the menu, or reviving any pork or beef version.

what_it_is: Small shareable or palate-resetting plates beside the main food.
current_members: NONE DECIDED (Chaat Elote and Dal-Frijol Dip exist only as backlog ideas)
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: Core 5 sessions showing missing freshness, crunch or a vegetarian shareable would justify testing one side.
must_not_happen: Adding sides before any main dish is proven, or sides that add fryer or comal load.

what_it_is: Guest journey has no dessert stage and the table stage is food and drink led. Dessert is not strategically important yet.
current_members: NONE DECIDED (Cardamom Churros exists only as a backlog idea)
status: DEFERRED: the Core 5 and pairing are unproven and a dessert would add fryer load at the known fryer peak
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: Guest feedback from real tastings asking for a finish, or Core 5 showing spare kitchen capacity. CONCEPT ONLY: a cooling cardamom or fruit finish.
must_not_happen: Building a dessert programme or recipe before the main food works.

what_it_is: Non-alcoholic drinks given equal care to beer, paired to each Core 5 dish.
current_members: Proposed primary NA drinks: agua-fresca-style fruit and lime; spiced-citrus botanical; tea with tamarind or hibiscus; lime and saline; lassi-style spiced drink
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: Tasting beside each dish decides which drinks stay; bar speed and dairy-cold-chain checks can remove one.
must_not_happen: Treating NA as a lesser option, or making any health, strength or labelling claim.

what_it_is: Beers proposed to pair with the Core 5. Not brewed; a qualified brewer decides styles and recipes.
current_members: Candidates: mexican-lager; pilsner; witbier; hefeweizen; vienna-amber
status: Proposed pairings; not brewed or tasted
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: Brewer feasibility and pairing tastings could add, merge or drop styles.
must_not_happen: Claiming brewed beer, or letting food needs choose recipes the brewer has not approved.

what_it_is: Rotating or special dishes for later, after a stable core exists.
current_members: NONE DECIDED (backlog mentions Kathal Barbacoa Taco, Baingan Bharta Tostada, Aloo Tikki Taco)
evidence_that_would_expand_or_remove: A proven core, stable supply and spare kitchen capacity.
must_not_happen: Planning seasonal items before the core is stable, or implying seasonal supply exists.
